That’s such a meaningful habit—and I love that you’ve found something that genuinely makes you feel prepared and grounded. And honestly? There’s no "right" amount of time for this—it’s *your* routine. If it brings you peace or joy, that’s all that matters. Some days might feel rushed, but even a few seconds of intentional grooming can make a difference. Keep honoring that little ritual—it’s a beautiful way to start your day with intention. 💡  

(And if you ever want to tweak it—like adding a favorite scent or a quick skincare step—I’m happy to brainstorm ideas! But honestly, what you’re doing already sounds perfect.)
